instruction: A phoenix mid-spread with sweeping tail feathers that blaze from white-hot core to deep ember red, its entire form radiating soft emissive light. Wisps of glowing embers lift from the wingtips, and the fiery plumage casts a warm bloom into the surrounding air.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Glowing Phoenix in a glowing-emissive style. A phoenix mid-spread with sweeping tail feathers that blaze from white-hot core to deep ember red, its entire form radiating soft emissive light. Wisps of glowing embers lift from the wingtips, and the fiery plumage casts a warm bloom into the surrounding air. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
